entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I'm calling about my VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I need to return it, but I'm just so confused by the whole process on the website.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, it's not broken or anything. It works fine. It's just... I tried to return it a while ago, maybe on the ninth day after I got it. I was having a real problem online. It felt like the whole system was down.

I'm very sorry to hear you had trouble with our site. Let me check... Yes, it looks like we did have a known website error that was causing issues for a few hours about three weeks ago. My apologies for that. So just to confirm, you'd like to return it because it wasn't the right fit for you?

Yes, that's right. And I really did try to do it then, but the page just wouldn't load properly. I couldn't print the label or anything. I even took a screenshot because I was so frustrated, but I don't know what to do with it. Can't you just help me?

Of course, I can help. And thank you for your patience with that system issue. Let me just pull up your order details and our return policy... Okay, I see your order here. It looks like it was delivered 35 days ago.
Yes, that sounds about right. I hope that's not a problem.
Not at all. According to our policy, all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. So you are well within the timeframe.
Oh! Really? That's such a relief. I was so worried because of all the trouble online. I thought I'd missed my chance.

I completely understand. I've just gone ahead and processed that return for you. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on file right now. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it in the mail. Once we receive it, you'll see a full refund in 3-5 business days.
That's wonderful. You've been so much help. Thank you, Sarah.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Have a great day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
